positions.name: Warner Bros. Discovery

positions.name: Delta Air Lines
positions.catalyst: Brent fell a fourth straight session to $100.47 (-3.40) and Nymex to $97.12 (-3.18) - the longest losing streak in three months, directly cutting jet-fuel input costs.

positions.driver: Jet fuel cost relief on four-day crude slide
